name: Robust Depth-Range Estimation
definition: Estimates a robust clipped depth range [z_min, z_max] for binning by sampling visible Gaussians, applying a near-depth shift, and selecting percentiles via exact order statistics.
summary: Robust Depth-Range Estimation calculates a clipped depth range for binning using percentile-based selection via exact order statistics, distinguishing itself from median methods by covering most geometry while excluding outliers.
